MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Orientation refers to.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Orientation refers to.

OrientationID.description: Unique identifier of this Object Orientation instance.

OrientationTime.description: Time this Orientation instance was produced.

General.description: General classification data of the Object.

ObjectType.description: Type of the Object: one of Digital Human, Generic.

MediaType.description: Media type of the Object: one of Speech, Audio, Visual, Audio-Visual, Haptic, Smell, RADAR, LiDAR, Ultrasound.

prefixItems.description: α: by default (ISO 8855) the yaw, about Z, in degrees.
β: by default (ISO 8855) the pitch, about Y′, in degrees.
γ: by default (ISO 8855) the roll, about X″, in degrees.

Orientation.description: The Object's orientation: three Euler angles (α, β, γ) or a unit quaternion of four numbers. By default (ISO 8855) the angles are degrees, intrinsic rotations first α about Z (yaw), then β about Y′ (pitch), then γ about X″ (roll), positive by the right-hand rule, α and γ in (−180, 180], β in [−90, 90]; a quaternion is (w, x, y, z) with w ≥ 0. The Spatial Qualifier of the data that carry it states another representation, order or convention.

OrientAccuracy.description: Estimated accuracy of each Euler angle (α, β, γ) in Orientation (degrees).

OrientVelocity.description: Angular velocity of the Object's orientation (α, β, γ) (degrees/s).

OrientVelocityAccuracy.description: Estimated accuracy of each angular velocity component (α, β, γ) (degrees/s).

OrientAccel.description: Angular acceleration of the Object's orientation (α, β, γ) (degrees/s²).

OrientAccelAccuracy.description: Estimated accuracy of each angular acceleration component (α, β, γ) (degrees/s²).

SpatialQualifier.description: Spatial Qualifier stating the representation of this Orientation (Euler angles or quaternion), the order of the rotations or of the numbers, and the frame and axes.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Orientation instance in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Orientation instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
